supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic HTTPS activity went to update.casebinder.co, whereas the inventory lists update.casebinder.com as the approved CaseBinder update domain. The hostname in the observed connections therefore differs from the approved hostname.

The repeated proxy connections are associated with casebinderupd.exe running as noah.kim from the user's AppData\Local\CaseBinder directory, rather than the inventory-listed C:\Program Files\CaseBinder path.

The same updater process made repeated proxy connections to the mismatched hostname from 13:39 through 14:09 UTC, with intervals roughly consistent with the alerted periodic pattern; one attempt received a proxy 503 and later attempts received status 200.

The combination of an update hostname differing from the approved domain and an updater executing from a user-local path supports treating the alerted connections as likely malicious, rather than as the approved CaseBinder updater activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT requests and tunnel metadata, not the HTTPS contents; they do not establish what data or content passed through the tunnels.
The provided records do not include a hash, signature validation, or provenance for the user-local updater executable.
The records identify the requested hostname but do not establish the destination's resolved IP, certificate details, ownership, or reputation.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish who controls update.casebinder.co.
The evidence does not establish that the updater downloaded or executed malicious content, or that data was exfiltrated.
The evidence does not establish whether the user-local executable was an unauthorized copy, a legitimate installation variant, or otherwise altered.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and analyze the updater executable, including its hash, digital signature, origin, and comparison with a verified CaseBinder installer.
Review DNS resolution, proxy gateway details, and TLS certificate information for update.casebinder.co during the connection times.
Obtain endpoint and proxy records for the full sessions, including any download or file-write activity attributable to the updater.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox updater and client processes ran on WS-NKIM-01; Dropbox is not among the approved services in the supplied inventory. Treat as a separate finding, not evidence deciding this alert. Records: T175-00179, T175-00214.

An ali.hassan network logon was recorded on WS-AHASSAN-01 with WS-NKIM-01 as the workstation name, despite the stated remote-administration practice. The available record does not link this activity to the alerted updater connections. Record: T175-00182.
The user proxy setting was changed to disabled on WS-NKIM-01 during the review window. The available evidence does not link that change to the alerted updater activity. Record: T175-00194.
